welcome.title: Feel like yourself while your body changes.
welcome.intro: Interim shows you how you look today, and what to wear and how to style your hair for the days ahead. It is made for anyone going through a change, including the changes that come with illness.
welcome.reassurance: You choose what to share, and you can delete everything at any time.
welcome.footnote: Interim is about how you look and what to wear. It does not give medical advice.

language.title: Choose your language
language.intro: Interim will use it for everything you read.
language.draftsNote: A language marked Draft has not been checked by a native speaker yet.

situation.title: What is changing for you?
situation.intro: Choose the one that fits best. You never need to name a condition or a medicine.
situation.groupIllness: Often part of illness or its care

blurbs.hair_loss_ahead: Your hair is thinning, or you expect it to. Plan for each stage, from thinning to growing back.
blurbs.hair_patches: Hair is coming out in patches, and it may come and go.
blurbs.face_fullness: Your face looks fuller or different, and it may settle again.
blurbs.after_surgery: Your body has a new shape. Fit and comfort come first, and body photos stay off until you turn them on.
blurbs.skin_colour: Your skin tone is shifting, and colours that used to suit you may not now.
blurbs.weight_change: Your weight is going up or down, on purpose or not, and your clothes sizes are changing.
blurbs.midlife_change: Changes in your hair and body through midlife. Volume and cut matter most.
blurbs.after_a_baby: Hair shedding after having a baby. Interim steers you away from big cuts for now.
blurbs.going_grey: Growing out your grey in stages, instead of dyeing it.
blurbs.textured_growth: Growing out textured hair, from very short to shoulder length.
blurbs.beard_growth: Growing a beard, from stubble to full.

setup.title: A few things about you
setup.intro: These shape how Interim talks to you and what it shows.
setup.toneTitle: How should Interim talk to you?

practical.label: Just practical
practical.description: What changed and one thing to do. No talk about feelings.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Kind and steady, with a short note at the start of each check in.

setup.headCoveringHelp: If you do, Interim will not show hairstyles or wigs on your photos.

consent.title: Before you add photos
consent.intro: Your photos, and what Interim learns from them, are personal. Here is exactly what happens to them.
consent.keepBody: Your photos, the measurements taken from them, your answers and your cards. Nothing is sold or used for advertising.
consent.helperYoucam: YouCam, by Perfect Corp, receives your photos so it can measure them and preview looks.
consent.helperGoogle: Google receives measurements, your situation, what you are getting ready for and the tone you chose, so it can write your notes. It never receives photos.
consent.retentionTitle: How long to keep your photos

standard.label: Delete after 30 days
standard.description: Photos and previews are deleted 30 days after they are taken. Measurements and cards stay until you delete your profile.

extended.label: Keep my history
extended.description: Keep them until you delete them, or until 24 months after your last check in. This lets Interim compare over time and show earlier looks.

consent.confirmStore: Interim may store my photos and measurements.
consent.confirmYoucam: YouCam (Perfect Corp) may process my photos.
consent.confirmGoogle: Google may process my measurements and settings, but not my photos.
consent.confirmOwn: The photos will only be of me.
consent.deleteAnytime: You can delete your profile and everything in it at any time.
consent.incomplete: Choose how long to keep photos and tick each box to continue.
consent.outdated: The consent text has changed. Reload this page and read it again.

ready.title: You are set up
ready.intro: Interim has what it needs to start.
ready.next: Your first check in is a few photos and two quick questions. It is not in this version yet.
ready.deleteBody: This removes your profile, photos, measurements and cards. It cannot be undone.

auth.signInIntro: Welcome back. Your profiles are waiting.
auth.signUpIntro: An account keeps your profiles safe and lets you open them on any device.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A few words you will remember work well.
auth.privacy: Your email is used only to sign you in. Brevo sends our emails, and Google signs you in if you choose it. Neither receives your photos.
auth.invalid: That email and password do not match.
auth.unverified: Please confirm your email first. Open the link we sent, or ask for a sign-in link instead.
auth.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign in did not work. Please try again or use another way.
auth.magicIntro: Enter your email and we will send a link that signs you in. No password needed.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send a link to choose a new one.
auth.resetIntro: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
auth.checkVerify: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email.
auth.checkMagic: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
auth.checkReset: If {email} has an account, we sent a link to choose a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
auth.checkSpam: Not there? Look in your spam folder.
auth.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.

account.title: Your account
account.passwordSet: You sign in with a password. You can choose a new one by email.
account.passwordNone: You have no password. You can sign in with a link or Google, or choose a password by email.
account.deleteBody: This deletes your account and every profile in it, with all photos, measurements and cards. It cannot be undone.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Interim
verify.intro: Confirm your email to finish creating your Interim account.

magic.subject: Your Interim sign-in link
magic.intro: Use this link to sign in to Interim. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.

reset.subject: Choose a new Interim password
reset.intro: Use this link to choose a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.

exists.subject: You already have an Interim account
exists.intro: Someone used this email to create an Interim account, but you already have one. You can sign in below.

email.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

settings.title: Your choices
settings.intro: Change how Interim talks to you, or whether it shows hair. You can change these any time.

companionFallback.practical: Here’s what changed since last time, and a few options for what’s coming up.
companionFallback.warm: Things look a little different this time, and that’s a normal part of this stage. Here are a few looks that still feel like you, for whatever is coming up.
companionFallback.light: New check in, new options. Here are a few looks to try for what’s coming up.

back_to_work: I’ve had some changes this year. I’m glad to be back.
Thanks for asking. I’d rather talk about work today.
It’s a long story. What did I miss?
family_event: Yes, my hair’s different. It’s so good to see you.
I’ll tell you about it another time. How have you been?
date: Things have changed for me lately. I’m happy to talk about it another time.
I’d rather hear about you first.
photos: Can we take one more? I want to pick my favourite.
Can I see it before it goes up?
video_call: New look this month. Shall we get started?
going_out: It’s a change I’m still getting used to. Anyway, what are we having?
I’d rather not get into it today.
